constraints: If fileName is an empty string (""), the standard Save file dialog box is displayed for the user to choose name/location/format; a default name from SET PICTURE FILE NAME, if any, is pre-filled.
If fileName is just a file name (no path), the file is created next to the database structure file; the file extension must be included.
codec may be a file-extension-style string (e.g. ".gif") or a MIME type (e.g. "image/jpeg"); available codecs can be listed via PICTURE CODEC LIST.
If codec is omitted, the codec is inferred from fileName's extension; if there is no usable extension or codec, the picture defaults to PICT format.
If the extension does not correspond to any available codec, the file is not saved and the OK system variable is set to 0.
If the target write format matches the picture's current format and no transformation has been applied, the picture is written as-is without re-encoding.
On success, the Document system variable holds the full pathname of the created file and OK is set to 1; otherwise OK is set to 0.
